column1: The following applies to all the above cable types:
Check for correct type and insulation level.
Check for correct size and number of conductors.
Check for installation in correct tray.
Check for correct connectors on both cable ends.
Check for correct conduit and conduit support.
Check for correct tagging (both ends and individual conductors).
Megger test and list of results (cable number and M reading).
Check correct terminations (including ground and shield).
Contractor to provide this information on separate sheet(s).  These sheets must be dated and signed.
